taskDescription: Portfolio Android app (tjshea90/Portfolio, Kotlin+Compose, sideloaded on Android 10 Go MT8168 tablet, rarely online). Goal: saved offline articles must open when tapped offline. Intent: Tj reads app offline; comprehensive offline viewing is core use.
currentStatus: DONE: W1-W3 in TASKS.md ticked; v8.4 released. UNVERIFIED: resolver never run against live Google (no device; curl egress blocked by hook), so real-world save rate unknown.
keyDecisions: Decision: resolve Google News links to publisher URL before fetch — Reason: they are JS redirects, plain GET gets no article
Decision: file saved page under list's original URL — Reason: reader looks up target.url, avoids key mismatch
Decision: fall back to headline+summary card when full page unsavable — Reason: every linked story must open something offline
Decision: onFinished callback on OfflineSync instead of VM init block — Reason: tools/checkinit.py forbids properties declared below init
failedApproaches: Approach: live curl test of Google News → Result: blocked by pre-bash-safety hook (NETWORK_EGRESS) → Lesson: do not bypass; resolver verified by unit tests only
Approach: init block in PortfolioViewModel to reload saved URLs → Result: checkinit.py failed → Lesson: use callback/LaunchedEffect, not init

ui/OfflineSync.kt: NewsItem-based savePages, resolveGoogle, onFinished callback
